lesson_1.title: Largest First
lesson_1.task:
A greedy selection system is processing a dynamic numeric dataset.

System Requirement:
Repeatedly identify and extract the largest available element from the array until no elements remain.

Behavior Rules:
- At each step, select the maximum remaining value
- Remove it from the dataset
- Preserve selection order in output

Output Requirement:
Return a list of selected values in the order they were removed.

lesson_1.title: Smallest First
lesson_1.task:
A sorting simulation engine is operating on an unsorted dataset.

System Requirement:
Repeatedly select the smallest available element until all values have been processed.

Behavior Rules:
- Always choose the minimum remaining value at each step
- Remove selected value from the dataset

Output Requirement:
Return all selected values in ascending selection order.

lesson_1.title: Greedy Sum
lesson_1.task:
A resource optimization system is analyzing numerical priority values.

System Requirement:
Select the three highest values from the dataset and compute their total sum.

Behavior Rules:
- Identify the top 3 largest numbers
- Sum them together
- If fewer than 3 elements exist, sum all available elements

Output Requirement:
Return a single integer representing the computed sum.

lesson_1.title: Closest Number
lesson_1.task:
A numeric matching system is evaluating proximity-based selection.

System Requirement:
Given a target value, determine the element in the dataset that is closest to it.

Behavior Rules:
- Compute absolute distance from target
- Select the smallest distance
- If multiple values are equally close, choose the smaller value

Output Requirement:
Return the selected closest number.

lesson_1.title: Greedy Path
lesson_1.task:
A grid traversal engine is simulating path optimization through weighted nodes.

System Requirement:
Start from the initial position and move through the grid by always selecting the highest available adjacent value.

Behavior Rules:
- At each step, choose the largest adjacent cell value
- Move sequentially according to greedy selection
- Accumulate visited values

Output Requirement:
Return the total sum of all visited cells.

lesson_2.title: Philippine Cashier
lesson_2.task:
A national cashier system is performing automated currency breakdown operations.

System Requirement:
Decompose a given amount using Philippine denominations in a greedy manner: [20, 10, 5, 1].

Behavior Rules:
- Always use the largest denomination first
- Minimize total number of coins
- Return counts per denomination in order [20,10,5,1]

Output Requirement:
Return a list of integers representing coin counts.

lesson_2.title: US Cashier
lesson_2.task:
A currency breakdown system is simulating US coin optimization.

System Requirement:
Break down a given value using denominations [25, 10, 5, 1] using a greedy strategy.

Behavior Rules:
- Prioritize highest denomination first
- Minimize coin usage
- Return counts in order [25,10,5,1]

Output Requirement:
Return list of coin counts.

lesson_2.title: Coin Breakdown Report
lesson_2.task:
A financial analytics system is evaluating transaction efficiency.

System Requirement:
Compute the total number of coins used when performing a greedy coin breakdown using Philippine denominations [20, 10, 5, 1].

Behavior Rules:
- Perform greedy breakdown first
- Sum all coin counts

Output Requirement:
Return a single integer representing total coins used.

lesson_2.title: Custom Coin System
lesson_2.task:
A configurable currency engine is using a custom denomination set.

System Requirement:
Break down a value using coins [1, 3, 4] using greedy selection.

Behavior Rules:
- Always pick highest denomination first
- Continue until value is fully reduced

Output Requirement:
Return list of counts in order [1,3,4].

lesson_2.title: Exact Change Validator
lesson_2.task:
A validation system checks whether a value can be represented using a given coin system.

System Requirement:
Determine whether exact change can be formed using greedy decomposition logic.

Behavior Rules:
- If value is negative, return False
- Otherwise determine feasibility using provided denominations

Output Requirement:
Return True or False.

lesson_3.title: Sort by End Time
lesson_3.task:
An event scheduling engine requires preprocessing of event timelines.

System Requirement:
Sort a collection of events based on their end time values in ascending order.

Behavior Rules:
- Each event is represented as a pair/list
- Sorting must be stable where possible

Output Requirement:
Return sorted event list.

lesson_3.title: Event Scheduler
lesson_3.task:
A scheduling optimization engine is selecting non-overlapping tasks.

System Requirement:
Maximize the number of events that can be scheduled without time conflicts.

Behavior Rules:
- Events must not overlap
- Greedy selection based on optimal ordering

Output Requirement:
Return maximum number of scheduled events.

lesson_3.title: Conflict Detector
lesson_3.task:
A timeline validation system checks whether two events overlap in execution.

System Requirement:
Determine whether two time intervals intersect.

Behavior Rules:
- Overlap exists if time intervals share any common duration
- Touching endpoints are not considered overlap

Output Requirement:
Return True if conflict exists, otherwise False.

lesson_3.title: Total Time Scheduled
lesson_3.task:
A scheduling analyzer computes total active coverage time from selected intervals.

System Requirement:
Calculate the total non-overlapping time covered by given intervals.

Behavior Rules:
- Merge overlapping intervals
- Sum total covered duration

Output Requirement:
Return integer total time.

lesson_3.title: Room Allocator
lesson_3.task:
A resource allocation system assigns events into limited rooms.

System Requirement:
Assign events to rooms ensuring no overlapping events share the same room.

Behavior Rules:
- Maximum of two rooms allowed
- Minimize room usage
- Allocate greedily based on schedule order

Output Requirement:
Return number of rooms used.
